title: Turn off the burner under a pot of burning oil
household_need: Burning oil in a pot on the hob: the heat must be shut off at once, before the fire spreads, and water makes it explode. The time scale is that of an oil pan fire under wall cabinets without a range hood: the cabinets are at risk after as little as 40 s of free burning and can ignite from 75 s (Budnick and Klein, NBSIR 75-788, 1976); here the flame spreads at 48 s nominal (64 s easy, 32 s hard, which is about 1.25x short of the 40 s). The task requires only the burner off and the knob released: in this abstraction that puts the flame out within seconds, and no lid is used (lid step removed 2026-11-02). Real guidance also covers the pan with a lid, and cutting the heat alone does not put out burning oil.
instruction: The oil in the pot on the stove may catch fire at an unpredictable time. Wait for visible flames, then turn off its burner before the fire spreads: its knob is the middle one of the five and goes off with a quarter turn clockwise (seen from above), to its stop. The gas is off only within 10 degrees of that stop, and it counts once no gripper touches the knob, so let go. The pot's front handle overhangs the cooktop: its edge is 6 cm behind the knob's axis, 5 to 9 cm above the knob.
core_interventions: turn the centre burner knob to OFF and release

process.state: flame intensity f, initially zero until ignition
process.model: Before ignition: f = 0; at the sampled time, if the burner is on: f = f0; burner on: df/dt = g f (1 - f); burner off: df/dt = -f / 1 s; spread at f = 0.8

hidden.ignition_time: U[2, 8] s after the first observation; seeded and independent of difficulty

process.cue: flame cards in the pot (agent camera)

timing.event: visible ignition; heat off = knob below 10 deg with no hand contact after ignition
timing.rule: loss = flame exposure after ignition; spread at 0.8 fails; no completion before ignition

physical: knob at OFF by robot contact

arm_roles: right: knob (single arm); left stays at its ready pose
open_items: flame as Omni Flow or animated cards driven by f

the burning pot stands on the island cooktop, which has no wall cabinets or hood above it (the wall cabinets and the range hood are over the back counter): the under-cabinet fire gives the time scale, it is not shown, and the instruction does not mention cabinets
